scripts.package:offline: npm run build && mkdir -p release && cd dist && zip -r "../release/gradehub-$(node -p "require('../package.json').version")-offline.zip" . && cd .. && echo "→ release/gradehub-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-offline.zip"
scripts.package:server: npm run build:web && mkdir -p release && zip -r "release/gradehub-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-server.zip" dist/ server.js package.json package-lock.json && echo "→ release/gradehub-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-server.zip"
scripts.package:all: npm run package:offline && npm run package:server && npm run build
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && node scripts/write-electron-config.mjs && GSETTINGS_SCHEMA_DIR=$HOME/.local/share/electron-schemas electron . --no-sandbox --ozone-platform=x11
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && node scripts/write-electron-config.mjs && electron-builder
